evidence.reason: The suffix filter at lines 641-643 is the gate that decides which installed unit files are read and dependency-scanned. `.slice` is a real systemd unit type with a `[Unit]` section, and `Wants=` in that section starts the referenced unit. A foreign installed `ingress.slice` containing `Wants=crq-tick.service` is therefore never read, so its dependency edge on an expected CRQ unit can be missed and `discover` can still report `supported=True`. Adding `.slice` to the scanned suffix set is the smallest compatible correctness fix; this is an implementation defect in the existing dependency-scan behavior, not a proposal for a new requirement.
